clips.title: The story
paras: Jorn Skyseer brings word from Melor Stonehoof to promising hunters in the Barrens. Those who have proved their grit across Kalimdor are called to Hunter's Rise in Thunder Bluff for a harder trial.

Across the Barrens, Jorn Skyseer watches the crossings and encampments. He carries word from the elders of Hunter's Rise to hunters and warriors who have shown promise in the surrounding lands. Melor Stonehoof, a revered tauren mentor, has marked out a path for them.

At Hunter's Rise in Thunder Bluff, you meet Melor Stonehoof. The elder hunter asks if you have the resolve to venture into distant, perilous wilderness. His summons opens trials far beyond the safety of Mulgore, where hunters face the continent's fiercest predators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.
If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor. You will find him on Hunter's Rise.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, friend, you have come. Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?
If so, young adventurer, then listen on...
